errors.text_span: Das Diagramm zeigt offenbar die Entwicklung des US-amerikanischen Handels auf Basis von Daten des US Bureau of Economic Analysis
errors.evidence: The chart represents exports, imports, and the balance in billion US dollars from 2020 to 2023, not the development of US trade based on data from the US Bureau of Economic Analysis.

errors.text_span: wobei die x-Achse vermutlich eine Zeitachse darstellt
errors.evidence: The x-axis is clearly labeled with years (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023), not 'presumably' a timeline.
The chart spans only four years (2020–2023), not several decades.
The machine-generated description does not mention that the chart illustrates exports, imports, and the balance in billion US dollars over time.
The description does not mention the left vertical axis labeled 'in Mrd. US-Dollar' with a range from 0 to 400 and the right vertical axis with a range from -200 to 400.
The description does not mention the legend identifying the blue line as 'Importe (linke Skala)', the red line as 'Exporte (linke Skala)', and the bars as 'Saldo (rechte Skala)'.

The description does not mention the structural details of the chart, such as the blue line starting at 200 in 2020 and rising to 350 by 2023, the red line starting at 100 in 2020 and rising to 175 by 2023, and the bars representing the balance starting short in 2020 and becoming longer over time.
The description does not mention the x-axis labels, which are years (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023).

errors.text_span: Aufgrund der eingeschränkten Sichtbarkeit des Diagramms – ein erheblicher Teil ist durch den umgebenden Text verdeckt – lassen sich die Achsenbeschriftungen, Skalierungen und genauen Wertebereiche nicht vollständig ablesen.
errors.evidence: The image is fully visible, and axis labels, scales, and values are clearly readable. The claim of partial obstruction is incorrect and misleading.
